Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Copper accounts for most of the increase in your cost breakdown—it sounds like recovering that pressure is your main concern. We value our longstanding partnership and want a fair adjustment that recognises substantiated cost changes and supports predictable business for both sides. How can we reconcile the verified cost evidence with your calculation on a comparable basis to reach a durable agreement?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. We have reviewed your proposal and the verified data regarding PPI-C241 and the volume forecast, which we have now factored into our calculation.

Extending payment terms to 90 days would significantly increase the unit price, so we must maintain 30 days net to offer you the most competitive rate. Reflecting the verified cost and volume changes, we can offer a revised price of €368.42 per unit at 30 days payment. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. As an alternative, we offer a price of €368.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel at standard terms. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
